blocks.head: alt The user currently has permission at the cloud

state_rules.rule:
eq < cloudB | ('buffer' : nils , UserX : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'publishToggle' cloudB | ('toggle') 
= < cloudB | ('buffer' : 'toggle' , UserX : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > $ cloudB 'acknowledgeReceipt' UserX .

eq < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : Permission , ..) , ...) > $ cloudB 'revokePermission' cloudB | (UserX) 
= < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : false , ..) , ...) > .

ceq < cloudB | ('buffer' : Message , deviceB : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'releaseMessage' cloudB 
= < cloudB | ('buffer' : nils , deviceB : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > $ cloudB 'publishMessage' deviceB | (Message) if Message =/= nils .

eq < deviceB | ('on' : false , ..) > $ cloudB 'publishMessage' deviceB | ('toggle') 
= < deviceB | ('on' : true , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | (..) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX) @ S < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX) @ S < UserX | (..) > .
